svg.title: SysWatchdog corrected system flowchart
svg.desc: Corrected flowchart: crash prediction is embedded inside the notifier, and VM multi-machine monitoring is a fully separate parallel GUI panel with per-machine status cards.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does SysWatchdog start up?')
sendPrompt('How does OS detection work on startup?')
sendPrompt('How does the psutil polling loop work?')
g.text: CPU · RAM · Disk · Processes every 1–2 s

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is CPU monitored per core?')
sendPrompt('How is RAM monitored?')
sendPrompt('How is disk I/O monitored?')
sendPrompt('What thresholds trigger an alert?')
sendPrompt('How does crash prediction work inside the notifier?')
g.text: Reads rolling usage history from SQLite

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the alert notification say when a process is predicted to crash?')
sendPrompt('What choices does the user have when the danger alert fires?')
sendPrompt('How does the auto-save engine find and back up open files?')
sendPrompt('What happens on a manual user save?')
sendPrompt('How does the incremental backup engine work?')
sendPrompt('How does local folder backup work?')
sendPrompt('How does USB external drive backup work?')
sendPrompt('How does cloud backup to Google Drive or OneDrive work?')
sendPrompt('What gets written to the SQLite database?')
g.text: Usage history · backup log · risk scores

svg.text: Separate GUI panel — VM / Multi-machine monitor
Live dashboard tab (runs independently alongside main monitor)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does SysWatchdog detect if it is inside a VirtualBox or VMware VM?')
g.text: dmidecode / WMI → identifies VirtualBox · VMware · Hyper-V · WSL

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Flask agent on each machine send data to the dashboard?')
g.text: Flask agent running on each machine / VM
Exposes /stats endpoint · polled every 2 s by central app

svg.text: Per-machine status cards (one card per machine)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What information does each machine card show in the dashboard?')
sendPrompt('What does a warning status look like on a machine card?')
sendPrompt('What does a critical machine card look like and what does it trigger?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a remote machine hits critical status?')
g.text: On that machine via its agent

svg.text: Each card updates live and independently. Main flow runs on the local machine only.
